method: Only confirmed damaged perimeter strips are filled from image_gen edits. Central RGBA preserved. All displayed fences use web/cage-fence.js.

C00.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a pixel-art game facility C00. Remove ONLY the entire OUTERMOST cyan/blue metal cage perimeter fence, all its posts, shadows and glow, and any blocky editing remnants from removing those old posts. The game will draw a NEW fence separately; your output must contain NO cyan perimeter rail or perimeter posts at all. Replace where the outer fence stood with seamless matching adjacent floor/terrain/wall texture. Remove ALL brown rectangular post-shadow squares, blocky clone seams and dark/orange blemishes immediately along the outer border. Fill with continuous matching natural orange dirt texture. Keep EXACT same complete multi-hex floor silhouette, dimensions/aspect, framing, materials, viewpoint, colors, all INTERNAL structures, original internal fences/handrails/sports nets, objects and scene layout. Keep all the existing interior detail unchanged. No new structures, no relocation, no text, no cast shadow outside. Fill the entire interior floor up to the original outer silhouette, no transparent gaps within the floor. Transparent alpha ONLY outside the complete original footprint. Do not simplify a multi-cell shape into a single hexagon. No borders or grid or decorative background. Output ONE cleaned scene with no outer fence.
